mapper.sql: SELECT a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",a.DEV_ID AS "developerId",d.DEV_NM AS "name", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName",a.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",COALESCE(j.CODE_NM,a.JOB_CD) AS "jobName", a.INPUT_END_DT AS "endDate",a.EXT_PSBL_CD AS "extensionPossibilityCode",a.EXT_CNT AS "extensionCount", COALESCE(a.MOD_DTTM,a.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt",a.ASGN_STAT_CD AS "statusCode", d.JOB_CD AS "primaryJobCode",d.GRADE_CD AS "gradeCode",p.CUST_CLNT_ID AS "customerId", COALESCE(g.CODE_NM,d.GRADE_CD) AS "gradeName",a.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",d.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_HR_DEV d ON d.DEV_ID=a.DEV_ID JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=a.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE g ON g.CODE_GRP_ID='GRADE' AND g.CODE=d.GRADE_CD
mapper.select: WHERE a.ASGN_ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF a
SELECT d.DEV_ID FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.DEV_ID=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT n.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId",n.NEED_SN::int AS "needSn",o.OPP_NM AS "opportunityName", n.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",COALESCE(j.CODE_NM,n.JOB_CD) AS "jobName", COALESCE(n.GRADE_CD,'MD') AS "gradeCode",COALESCE(g.CODE_NM,n.GRADE_CD,'MD') AS "gradeName", n.BGN_YM AS "startMonth",n.PRD_MCNT::int AS "durationMonths",n.NEED_CNT::int AS "requiredCount", (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN t WHERE t.OPP_ID=n.OPP_ID AND t.NEED_SN=n.NEED_SN AND t.TENT_STAT_CD IN ('ACT','CNVT')) AS "occupiedCount", o.OPP_STAT_CD AS "statusCode",o.CUST_CLNT_ID AS "customerId",o.WIN_PRBL_RT AS "winningProbability", n.MON_MM AS "monthlyMm",COALESCE(c.CLNT_NM,o.CUST_CLNT_ID) AS "customerName", COALESCE(s.CODE_NM,o.SALES_STEP_CD) AS "stageName" FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_ID=n.OPP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=o.CUST_CLNT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE s ON s.CODE_GRP_ID='SALES_STEP' AND s.CODE=o.SALES_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=n.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE g ON g.CODE_GRP_ID='GRADE' AND g.CODE=COALESCE(n.GRADE_CD,'MD') ORDER BY n.OPP_ID,n.NEED_SN
SELECT n.OPP_ID FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_ID=n.OPP_ID ORDER BY n.OPP_ID,n.NEED_SN FOR UPDATE OF n,o

SELECT t.TENT_ID::text AS "tentativeId",t.DEV_ID AS "developerId",t.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId", o.OPP_NM AS "opportunityName",t.NEED_SN::int AS "needSn",t.BGN_YM AS "startMonth",t.TENT_STAT_CD AS "statusCode" FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN t JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_ID=t.OPP_ID WHERE t.DEV_ID=#{developerId} AND t.TENT_STAT_CD IN ('ACT','CNVT') ORDER BY t.TENT_ID

SELECT t.TENT_ID::text AS "tentativeId",t.DEV_ID AS "developerId",t.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId", o.OPP_NM AS "opportunityName",t.NEED_SN::int AS "needSn",t.BGN_YM AS "startMonth",t.TENT_STAT_CD AS "statusCode" FROM TB_SL_TENT_ASGN t JOIN TB_SL_OPP o ON o.OPP_ID=t.OPP_ID WHERE t.TENT_STAT_CD IN ('ACT','CNVT') AND t.DEV_ID IN #{id} ORDER BY t.DEV_ID,t.TENT_ID

SELECT h.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",h.APLY_DT AS "effectiveDate",COALESCE(h.AFT_VAL,'') AS "afterValue" FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST h WHERE h.ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD='EARLY' AND h.ASGN_ID IN #{id} ORDER BY h.ASGN_ID,h.REG_DTTM DESC,h.HIST_SN DESC
SELECT s.SKILL_NM FROM TB_HR_DEV_SKILL s WHERE s.DEV_ID=#{developerId} ORDER BY s.SORT_ORD,s.SKILL_NM
mapper.sql: d.USE_YN='Y' AND d.DRCT_CLS_CD='DRCT' AND d.JOB_CD=#{jobCode} AND (d.JNCMP_DT IS NULL OR d.JNCMP_DT <= #{lastDay}) AND (d.RETIRE_DT IS NULL OR d.RETIRE_DT >= #{firstDay}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s WHERE s.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND s.WORK_STAT_CD='LEAVE' AND s.BGN_DT <= #{lastDay} AND (s.END_DT IS NULL OR s.END_DT >= #{firstDay}))
mapper.select: SELECT d.DEV_ID AS "developerId",COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.MON_MM) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' WHERE m.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND m.INPUT_YM=#{month}),0) AS "confirmedMm" FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE ORDER BY d.DEV_ID

SELECT d.DEV_ID AS "developerId",COALESCE((SELECT h.NEW_CTRT_MM FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST h WHERE h.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND h.ASGN_CHG_TYPE_CD IN ('INPUT','RATE') AND h.NEW_CTRT_MM IS NOT NULL AND to_char(h.APLY_DT,'YYYYMM') <= to_char(a.INPUT_END_DT,'YYYYMM') ORDER BY h.APLY_DT DESC,h.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1),a.CTRT_MM) AS "monthlyMm", a.EXT_PSBL_CD AS "extensionPossibilityCode" FROM TB_HR_DEV d JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID WHERE AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' AND a.INPUT_END_DT < #{firstDay} AND a.INPUT_END_DT >= CAST(#{baseMonth} AS date) ORDER BY d.DEV_ID,a.ASGN_ID

SELECT p.PLAN_MM AS "plannedMm",COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.MON_MM) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' WHERE m.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND a.JOB_CD=p.JOB_CD),0) AS "confirmedMm", ((extract(year FROM j.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(year FROM f.f0)::int)*12 +extract(month FROM j.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(month FROM f.f0)::int+1) AS "remainingMonths" FROM TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN p JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ j ON j.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT GREATEST((CAST(#{baseMonth} AS date)+interval '1 month')::date, date_trunc('month',j.CTRT_BGN_DT)::date) AS f0) f WHERE p.JOB_CD=#{jobCode} AND j.PROJ_STAT_CD='ING' AND j.CTRT_TYPE_CD!='IN' AND j.CTRT_BGN_DT <= #{lastDay} AND j.CTRT_END_DT >= #{firstDay} AND CAST(#{firstDay} AS date) >= f.f0 ORDER BY p.PROJ_ID,p.JOB_CD
